what: Benchmark 8 W7: how Lua is built (the same for every compiler: the arms', gcc -O0's, gcc -O2's, chibicc's)
compile: clj-run -m ccc.main -I spec/w7/include -I spec/w7/lua -D LUA_COMPAT_5_3 -D LUA_USE_POSIX <src.c> -o <src.s>   (or --batch)
test: cd visible/W7 && <lua> w7test.lua full <file>.lua   (passes: exit 0 and a line `W7-TEST-OK <file>.lua`)
